legalName: Petition to Restrict and Seal First Offender Records Where the Participant Was Exonerated and Discharged Before July 1, 2026
boundCodifiedTextRole: codified-text source only - the controlling Georgia legal review, whose Part 3 custom-pleading specification grounds the caption structure, pleading title, citations, proposed-order requirements and certificate of service; it is not included in the packet
routeSelectionNote: The composed pages carry no election control. The statutory route is stated in the instrument's own title and body, which is where this family's route determination lives. No participant-facing election is route-determined on this family.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest in this case
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest in this case
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of arrest, from the case papers or your Georgia criminal history report

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court and county named in the caption - the court that granted the discharge, and its county (State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal; your own case papers name both, and the instructions page says who can confirm them)
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court and county named in the caption - the court that granted the discharge, and its county (State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal; your own case papers name both, and the instructions page says who can confirm them)
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which court handled the case, and its level - State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal - is data the participant's own case papers carry; the packet must not default to Superior Court
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and level of the court that sentenced you and granted the discharge, and its county, from your case papers - the clerk of that court can confirm both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the existing criminal case, exactly as it appears on the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the existing criminal case, exactly as it appears on the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the filing is made in the existing criminal case under the existing case number, and that number lives on a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the existing criminal case, copied exactly from the court record - the clerk of the court that granted the discharge holds the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the exoneration and discharge - it must be before July 1, 2026 for this route
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the exoneration and discharge - it must be before July 1, 2026 for this route
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no discharge fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you were exonerated and discharged, from the discharge order where one was entered, or the date your sentence was completed where you were discharged as a matter of law - the clerk of the court that granted the discharge can help you locate it; if you are unsure whether you were discharged at all, stop and get help before filing

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Whether a discharge order was entered, or the discharge occurred as a matter of law without an order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Whether a discharge order was entered, or the discharge occurred as a matter of law without an order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which happened lives on the court's own record, which the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether the court entered a discharge order, or you were discharged as a matter of law without one - a discharge frequently was never entered despite completed probation, and the statute reaches both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: GCIC Offender Tracking Number (OTN) for the case, where known
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: GCIC Offender Tracking Number (OTN) for the case, where known
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the OTN lives on the criminal history record, which the platform never collects, inspects or authenticates
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the GCIC OTN for the case, copied from your Georgia criminal history report where it appears - the proposed order needs it to be actionable by GCIC, and the packet is usable without it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The sentence imposed under the First Offender Act
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The sentence imposed under the First Offender Act
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no sentence fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the sentence you received, from the final disposition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the First Offender sentence was imposed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the First Offender sentence was imposed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no sentence fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you were sentenced under the First Offender Act, from the final disposition - the clerk of the sentencing court holds it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest identified in the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest identified in the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of arrest, from the case papers or your Georgia criminal history report - the order names it so the agencies can identify the cycle

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court and county named in the caption - the court that granted the discharge, and its county (State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal; your own case papers name both, and the instructions page says who can confirm them) - proposed order caption

requiredBeforeFiling.why: which court handled the case, and its level - State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal - is data the participant's own case papers carry; the packet must not default to Superior Court
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and level of the court that sentenced you and granted the discharge, and its county, from your case papers - the clerk of that court can confirm both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the existing criminal case, exactly as it appears on the court record - proposed order caption
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the existing criminal case, exactly as it appears on the court record - proposed order caption
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the filing is made in the existing criminal case under the existing case number, and that number lives on a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the existing criminal case, copied exactly from the court record - the clerk of the court that granted the discharge holds the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: GCIC Offender Tracking Number (OTN) for the case, where known - proposed order caption
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: GCIC Offender Tracking Number (OTN) for the case, where known - proposed order caption
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the OTN lives on the criminal history record, which the platform never collects, inspects or authenticates
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the GCIC OTN for the case, copied from your Georgia criminal history report where it appears - the proposed order needs it to be actionable by GCIC, and the packet is usable without it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: OTN of the case, stated in the proposed order so the order is actionable by GCIC
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: OTN of the case, stated in the proposed order so the order is actionable by GCIC
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the OTN lives on the criminal history record, which the platform never collects, inspects or authenticates
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the GCIC OTN, copied from your Georgia criminal history report where it appears - a restriction order that does not identify the case for GCIC is not actionable

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting attorney served, identified as District Attorney or Solicitor-General for the county
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting attorney served, identified as District Attorney or Solicitor-General for the county
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no address for the prosecuting attorney and the participant writes it before service
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and mailing address of the prosecuting attorney - District Attorney or Solicitor-General - for the county where you file; the clerk's office can provide it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Method used to serve each recipient, chosen from those the certificate lists
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Method used to serve each recipient, chosen from those the certificate lists
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which method the participant uses is settled only when service actually happens
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how you actually served each recipient - registered or certified mail or statutory overnight delivery (statutorily sufficient under O.C.G.A. Sec. 42-8-62.2(c)); hand delivery or e-filing may also be used - confirmed with the clerk of the court named in the caption before filing, because local courts control their own filing and e-filing practice
